scope.summary: Enable a raster StudioDocument whose layer tree holds raster-domain StudioLayer nodes over one or more StudioArtboard containers. Support multiple named artboards in one document, each with its own pixel dimensions, background, guides, layer auto-nesting into the containing artboard, and export path, without forking the document. Reuse the canonical StudioArtboard primitive (14.23); geometry semantics defer to 14.6.
acceptance_criteria: multiple named artboards per document with independent dims/bg/guides/export path
layers auto-nest; no document fork; artboard ops promotion-gated
proof_targets: multi-artboard document runtime + Argus artboards-panel snapshot
expected_tests: live: create document with >=2 named artboards of differing dimensions; new pixel layer auto-nests into hovered artboard
argus: artboards panel shows per-artboard dims/background/export-path with stable author_ids

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Artboards in a raster document

risk_if_missed: Single-artboard-only documents; Photoshop/Affinity artboard workflows unsupported.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
